title: Apathesia
description: Just a modded cross-platform SMP featuring only server-sided mods to avoid any required downloads.
body:
Hello. I'm Muffins and I own a very chill 7 month old modded SMP that could always use a few more friendly faces.

We're a grief-free, helpful community that's always looking to have a good time.

We run seasonal events, occasional "special" weekends where settings will be tweaked or fun mods will be added temporarily.

We offer an environment free of p2w, gambling, economies, or any of the other things that are destroying the multiplayer MC scene.

All platforms can join, and all mods are server-sided only (Even our bedrockers can use proximity voice chat) so there are no downloads to worry about.

The server is modded with a focus on QoL, variety in exploration (over 400 extra structures and biomes to discover), and offering an actual end game.

We take a strong stance against hate speech of any kind, and value our LGBTQ+ members very much, with representation on the staff team and the playerbase. WE ARE A SAFE SPACE.
